checklists.title: Reusable checklists
checklists.description: Save a personal list and start a fresh task whenever you need it.
checklists.name: Checklist name
checklists.itemsHelp: One item per line. Use 1–10 items of up to 120 characters; blank lines are ignored.
checklists.independent: Changes to this list affect future copies. Tasks already started keep their own items and progress.
checklists.fresh: A new task will contain all items unchecked. The saved checklist stays ready to reuse.
checklists.failed: The checklist could not be saved. Try again.
checklists.removeHelp: Remove this saved checklist? Tasks started from it will remain.
